name: switch
title: Switch
summary: Turns a setting on or off, taking effect at once.
description: An on/off toggle that takes effect immediately. The track fills with ink when on and the thumb travels across; pressing squeezes the thumb. It is a native button with role=switch, so state lives in aria-checked and no engine is needed. An optional label wrapper makes the text part of the hit area.

anatomy.description: role=switch; aria-checked Wrapper rule: class and style land on this outermost element (what a caller sizes and places); every other attribute stays on the control.
Travels on translate, squeezes on scale while pressed. Carries kbd-instant.

Wraps the switch and its text; a click on the text toggles and the text is the accessible name. In the adapters it is rendered when there is a visible label, and `class` and `style` then land on it (the outermost element: what a caller sizes and places); every other attribute stays on the button.

label.description: Accessible name when there is no visible label.

slots.default: Visible label. When given, the switch is wrapped in the label part.

notes: Name it with the label wrapper, aria-labelledby, or the label prop (aria-label).
State is aria-checked, which is also what the recipe keys on.
A toggle from the keyboard moves the thumb instantly.
To set it from outside, control `checked`: React checked / onCheckedChange, Vue v-model:checked, Svelte bind:checked.

motion: thumb: translate over duration.move with easing.move (pointer only)
press (pointer only): thumb scales to motion.press-scale-sm over duration.press with easing.out-strong; none from Space / Enter
